title: Build Multi-Agent Contract Review Pipeline with LangGraph & Postgres Checkpointing
description: We are looking for a senior AI engineer to architect a multi-agent legal document review workflow in Python using LangGraph. Key requirements: (1) parallel clause extraction, risk scoring, and compliance checks; (2) durable Postgres checkpointing so human-in-the-loop approvals survive service restarts; (3) strict sentence-level claim verification against our internal clause library; and (4) FastAPI endpoints with SSE progress streaming. Please share relevant production metrics.
screening_questions: Describe a LangGraph system you shipped with human-in-the-loop interrupts and durable checkpointing.
How do you measure and reduce unsupported claims in RAG outputs?

title: Upgrade Financial RAG Search to Hybrid BM25 + BGE-M3 with Cross-Encoder Reranking
description: Our current dense-only pgvector search misses exact regulatory codes, SEC filing identifiers, and financial acronyms. We need an IR/RAG specialist to implement hybrid BM25 + dense retrieval with Reciprocal Rank Fusion, add bge-reranker-v2-m3 reranking, and build an automated Recall@5 and nDCG@10 evaluation harness.
screening_questions: What Recall@5 and latency gains have you achieved with hybrid retrieval + reranking?

title: Next.js 15 + FastAPI Real-Time AI Operations Dashboard with Playwright E2E Suite
description: We need a principal full-stack engineer to build our customer-facing AI workflow dashboard in Next.js (TypeScript, Tailwind CSS) connected to our FastAPI backend via Server-Sent Events (SSE). Must include a Kanban pipeline view, inline evidence citations on hover, generated OpenAPI TypeScript client, and at least 10 end-to-end Playwright tests running in GitHub Actions.
screening_questions: Share an example of a Next.js + FastAPI streaming UI you built and how you tested it with Playwright.

title: Build Custom MCP Servers (Python SDK) with OAuth 2.1, Idempotency & Audit Logging
description: Looking for an engineer experienced with the official Model Context Protocol (MCP) Python SDK to build read/write tool servers exposing our internal clinical knowledge base and scheduling APIs. Requirements: Pydantic v2 input/output schemas, MCP tool annotations, Bearer token auth, idempotency keys on writes, and unit tests using an in-memory MCP client.
screening_questions: How do you enforce idempotency and least-privilege tool allowlists across MCP servers?

title: Local Open-Weight LLM Deployment (Ollama / vLLM) + Guardrails for FinTech Internal Copilot

screening_questions: What latency and cost reductions have you seen with tiered open-weight model routing?
